dedupe_keys.name: china public transport operation network dataset cptond 2025

description: CPTOND-2025 is a national vector dataset of China's public transport operation network, integrating bus networks of 350 cities and metro systems of 46 cities in mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan, about 3,408,000 km of operational routes (bus about 3,375,000 km, metro about 33,000 km). Shapefiles hold bus routes (140,371), bus stops (3,571,284), metro lines (992) and metro stations (17,731), with deduplicated stops and inter-station segments that carry origin and destination stop names in Chinese and English, segment distance and the number of routes using each segment; attributes include operating hours, fares and operating companies. It was built by researchers of the Beijing Municipal Institute of City Planning and Design and Beijing Jiaotong University from the 8684 route directories and the Amap bus API in June 2025, and described in Scientific Data (volume 13, article 188, 2026). Coverage is national at city, route and stop level for June 2025. The data are a free 2.2 GB zip on Figshare under CC BY 4.0, in WGS-84 with a stated 5.08 m average spatial accuracy. Caveats: it is a single snapshot without timetables, and Taiwan has metro data only because the API gives no bus data there. The dataset supports network flow, accessibility, cascading failure and resilience analysis of bus-metro networks, and relates to GTFS-based collections such as the 25-city public transport networks catalogued here.
